data.name: Title / Home / What are people saying about us

1.content: I've purchased hundreds and hundreds of files over the past 7 years. But there is nothing close to this support and professionalism. Not only is theme, simple , useful and modern, but again the support is remarkable.  Very happy I got this theme! Thank you!

2.content: I am a web developer for many years i haven't seen anything clear clean coded like journal it makes my live so much easier thanks for the great work you have done.

3.content: Great toolkit for Opencart. As a base platform, Opencart can be a nightmare to modify and get looking good. Journal takes away all the pain.

4.content: This theme is just amazing. With the new version J3 everything has become much easier to adjust...Great value for the price!

5.content: Amazing ways to customize so you don't end up with a site looking like everyone else's :) Unique sites are much better than clone sites, as they keep the customers interest and the bounce rate is a lot lower...

6.content: Outstanding customer support , i've used the support a few times and had replies within a day or so. Each time any issues i've had have been resolved with clear concise answers, many thanks

7.content: It's wonderful! Its look is stunning already with demo styles and you can customize every single aspect of the theme with a nice fine tuning...AMAZING!

8.content: This theme is amazing. It looks superb, everything works, the documentation is very very good. Very easy to use and implement.

9.content: EXCELLENT theme built with purpose and has been constantly updated and improved upon since I started using it in 2014. My go to theme.

10.content: This framework is absolutely super, the level of customization is incredible, the support takes a while to reply to your tickets but I guess they are very busy due to allot of people that buy this product, but I can live with that.
